# ClosedVPS

> Free, open-source CLI that buys a Hetzner Cloud server even while Hetzner is sold out. It retries every minute from the user's own computer or any machine that stays on (there's a Docker image), within price caps per server type and for all servers together, buys several with --count, and alerts the user on the desktop and optionally through ntfy, Discord, Slack, Telegram or a webhook. The server comes up behind a Hetzner firewall with no inbound rules, with SSH only over Tailscale, automatic security updates, Hetzner Backups when asked for and an optional Cloudflare Tunnel for websites. macOS, Linux, Windows. MIT.

Install: `curl -fsSL https://closedvps.com/install.sh | sh` (macOS, Linux) or `irm https://closedvps.com/install.ps1 | iex` (Windows). Then `closedvps create`. `closedvps upgrade` updates it.

## Docs

- [The home page as Markdown](https://closedvps.com/index.md): what it does, what you need, the stock retry, what the server gets, recovery when Tailscale breaks
- [Why ClosedVPS closes every port](https://closedvps.com/why): the October 2026 Linux bug (CVE-2026-98432) and, for each part of the setup, the NIST, CISA, CIS or vendor text that asks for it, quoted, plus where it falls short of CIS
- [How to lock down a Hetzner VPS by hand](https://closedvps.com/guide): the firewall, Tailscale, SSH and update steps in the Hetzner Console, without ClosedVPS
- [Claude Code on a Hetzner VPS](https://closedvps.com/claude-code): picking a server, `--claude`, logging in, Remote Control from a phone, opening dev servers over Tailscale, and the manual steps
- [When Hetzner is sold out](https://closedvps.com/sold-out): why CX and CAX types show unavailable since June 2026, what in-stock plans cost, and buying one when it's back
- [README](https://github.com/tulayha/closedvps/blob/main/README.md): quick start, everything it creates, security model, getting back in
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/tulayha/closedvps/blob/main/AGENTS.md): running it from a coding agent without prompts
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/tulayha/closedvps/blob/main/skills/closedvps/SKILL.md): instructions an agent loads to run ClosedVPS for a user, including how to watch a long run (--json events, exit codes). In Claude Code: `/plugin install closedvps --marketplace tulayha/closedvps`
